scope: Repeat all 84 v1 residual cells with only SwiGLU changed from SiLU(gate)*value to (1+SiLU(gate))*value. This adds a linear path using the same matrices, without new parameters. Keep the original epsilon, residual choices, data, teacher strengths, seeds, sampler, LR, optimizer, 512-update budget, 5% relative-MSE threshold and ranking. Initial weights match but initial outputs intentionally change. Do not mix numerical fixes into this learning ablation.
ranking: Rank by number of the 12 cells per variant reaching threshold. If all 12 pass, compare geometric-mean first-crossing updates. Otherwise compare worst final relative MSE across all 12 (nonfinite is worst); use median final error only as a tie-break. Report all seed/depth/strength regressions. Best means best among these declared small residual tests; it does not authorize replacing the main transformer. No retuning after outcomes.
